name: Circuit
definition: A racing venue that hosts Formula 1 races, identified by an integer circuit id and described by a circuit name, a host city/location, a country, and a latitude/longitude pair.
scope: Circuit identity and venue attributes used when a question names a circuit or asks where a race was held.

name: Race (Grand Prix event)
definition: One Formula 1 event in one season: a named Grand Prix held at a circuit on a calendar date within a championship year. Identified by raceId.
scope: The unit of analysis whenever a question says race, Grand Prix, or race No. N.

name: Driver
definition: A person who participates in Formula 1 races; identified by driverId and described by a reference name, forename, surname, nationality, date of birth and profile URL.
scope: Driver identity; questions may call a driver a player.

name: Constructor
definition: A Formula 1 team/entrant that supplies a car; identified by constructorId with a team name, nationality and profile URL.
scope: Team-level analysis and constructor championship questions.

name: Season
definition: A championship year. Each year is listed once with its season URL, and every race belongs to exactly one season year.
scope: Year-level filtering such as since 2010 or earliest recorded year.

name: Race Result
definition: One driver's classification in one race: starting grid slot, finishing position, position text, points, laps completed, finish time, fastest-lap data and result status.
scope: Race outcome analysis at driver x race grain.

name: Qualifying Result
definition: One driver's qualifying performance in one race, recording the qualifying position and the times set in the three qualifying periods (Q1, Q2, Q3).
scope: Qualifying questions including first/second/third period results and eliminations.

name: Pit Stop
definition: One pit-stop visit by a driver in a race, identified by a stop number and recorded with its lap, clock time and duration.
scope: Pit-stop counts, timing and duration analysis.

name: Result Status
definition: Lookup of the classified outcome of a race result: whether the car finished (status 1) or the reason it did not, e.g. accident, collision, engine failure, or a lapped classification such as +1 Lap.
scope: Any interpretation of why a driver did or did not finish a race.

name: Driver Standings Record
definition: A driver's cumulative championship standing after a given race, with cumulative points, championship position, position text and wins to date.
scope: Driver championship progress; one snapshot per driver per race.

name: Constructor Standings Record
definition: A constructor's cumulative championship standing after a given race, with cumulative points and championship position.
scope: Constructor championship progress; one snapshot per constructor per race.

name: Constructor Race Result
definition: The points a constructor scored in one individual race, together with a per-race constructor status.
scope: Constructor performance within a single race.

name: Race Identifier
definition: The surrogate integer race id that uniquely identifies a race. Phrases such as race No. N or race at N refer to this identifier, not to the season round and not to the year.
scope: Resolving an explicit race number in a question.

name: Race Name
definition: The Grand Prix name of a race, such as Canadian Grand Prix. The same name recurs once per season, so a name alone does not identify a unique race.
scope: Filtering or labelling races by their Grand Prix name.

name: Race Year
definition: The championship year the race belongs to.
scope: Year filtering on races, such as the 2008 Chinese Grand Prix or since 2010.

name: Race Date
definition: The calendar date on which the race was held, stored as a text date in YYYY-MM-DD form.
scope: Chronological ordering, earliest race, age-at-race and month extraction.

name: Circuit Name
definition: The official name of the circuit that hosted a race, such as Silverstone Circuit.
scope: Naming or filtering circuits.

name: Circuit Location
definition: The city or town where the circuit is located.
scope: Displaying venue location alongside coordinates.

name: Circuit Country
definition: The country of the circuit, stored as a text label using short forms such as UK and USA as well as full names such as Austria.
scope: Country-level circuit questions such as circuits in Austria.

name: Circuit Coordinates
definition: The geographic position of the circuit: latitude and longitude in decimal degrees, stored as two separate real columns.
scope: Coordinate and location questions about circuits or about the circuit of a named race.

name: Driver Full Name
definition: A driver's complete name, formed from the forename and surname columns. Questions that name a person, such as Lewis Hamilton or Bruno Senna, refer to this composed name.
scope: Matching a named person to a driver record.

name: Driver Reference Name
definition: The short machine-readable driver identifier, such as hamilton or bruno_senna, which is unique per driver.
scope: Disambiguating and displaying drivers by stable reference.

name: Driver Nationality
definition: The driver's nationality expressed as a text adjective such as German or British.
scope: Nationality filters on drivers.

name: Driver Date of Birth
definition: The driver's birth date stored as a YYYY-MM-DD text date; a larger value corresponds to a later birth date and therefore a younger driver.
scope: Age, oldest/youngest and birth-year-range questions.

name: Driver Profile URL
definition: The profile URL of the driver, used when a question asks for a driver's introduction website.
scope: Returning a driver's web reference.

name: Constructor Name
definition: The team name, such as McLaren or Williams.
scope: Naming and filtering constructors.

name: Constructor Nationality
definition: The constructor's nationality expressed as a text adjective such as British or German.
scope: Nationality filters on constructors, such as British constructors.

name: Constructor Profile URL
definition: The profile URL of the constructor, used for an introduction website of a team.
scope: Returning a constructor's web reference.

name: Finish Position
definition: The classified finishing position of a driver in a race. It is empty when the driver was not classified, in which case the position text is R.
scope: Ordering race results and selecting a race winner or a specific finishing rank.

name: Qualifying Position
definition: The driver's position on the qualifying classification for a race.
scope: Qualifying order, distinct from the period times.

name: Fastest Lap Rank
definition: Rank of a driver's fastest lap within the race; rank 1 identifies the fastest lap of the race.
scope: Identifying the fastest lap of a race.

name: Lap Number
definition: The lap number within a race, as recorded for lap times and pit stops.
scope: Locating a lap or pit stop within a race.

name: Race Winner / Champion
definition: The driver classified first in a race. Champion of a Grand Prix means the race winner, which is distinct from the season champion.
scope: Questions about who won or championed a particular race.

name: Finished Race
definition: Indicator that a driver was classified as finishing a race. It is authoritatively expressed by the Finished result status.
scope: Counting finishers or non-finishers in a race.

name: Race Participation
definition: A driver participated in a race when the results table contains at least one row for that driver in that race; counting those rows measures participation.
scope: Counting how many races a driver contested or checking whether a driver appeared.

name: Qualifying Period Elimination
definition: Elimination from a qualifying period: for the first period the five drivers with the slowest first-period times are eliminated and do not set a second-period time.
scope: Questions about drivers eliminated or knocked out in a qualifying period.

name: Accident
definition: The Accident result status, distinct from Collision and Collision damage, which are separate outcome categories.
scope: Counting or filtering results caused by an accident.

name: Race Points (Driver)
definition: Championship points a driver scored in a single race.
scope: Race-level scoring for a driver.

name: Race Points (Constructor)
definition: Championship points a constructor scored in a single race, stored in the constructor-results table.
scope: Race-level scoring for a team.

name: Cumulative Standings Points
definition: Cumulative championship points of a driver or constructor as of a given race, stored in the standings tables.
scope: Championship totals; one snapshot per participant per race.

name: Laps Completed
definition: The number of laps a driver completed in a race.
scope: Race-distance analysis and lapped-driver detection.

name: Finish Time
definition: The recorded race time of a driver. The winner's value is an absolute time in H:MM:SS.mmm; drivers classified behind the winner carry a relative gap beginning with a plus sign, expressed either in seconds or in M:SS.mmm. The value is empty when no classified time exists.
scope: Race-time questions, winner's time, and any timing comparison.

name: Time Gap to Winner
definition: The difference between a driver's race time and the winner's race time, stored as a plus-prefixed string that must be combined with the winner's absolute time for absolute comparisons.
scope: Gaps, incremental time, and percentage speed comparisons between drivers in one race.

name: Fastest Lap Speed
definition: Average speed in km/h of a driver's fastest lap in a race, stored as text with decimal places.
scope: Speed comparisons and fastest-lap questions.

name: Fastest Lap Time
definition: Lap time of a driver's fastest lap in a race, in M:SS.mmm form.
scope: Fastest-lap timing analysis.

name: Pit Stop Duration
definition: Duration of one pit stop in seconds, stored as a decimal text value.
scope: Pit-stop timing and duration analysis.

name: Average Pit Stop Duration
definition: Mean pit-stop duration for a driver, computed as the sum of that driver's stop durations divided by the number of stops.
scope: Comparing drivers by pit-stop efficiency.

name: Lap Time
definition: Time for one lap by one driver in one race, recorded with its lap number; dominantly in M:SS.mmm form with a small number of hour-long values in H:MM:SS.mmm.
scope: Lap-level timing and looking up a specific lap time.

name: Qualifying Period Time
definition: The best lap time a driver set in one qualifying period: first period, second period, or third period. An empty period time means the driver did not take part in that period.
scope: Q1/Q2/Q3 questions, including first qualifying period results.

name: Driver Age at Race
definition: The driver's age at the time of a race, derived from the difference between the race date and the driver's date of birth.
scope: Oldest/youngest driver questions.
